_about: GRAND SUV 63 (the model's cabin is the previous GLS's): its two round dials, the small screen between them and the floating centre screen are blank and share their materials with the whole dash, so each gets a board of its own, placed by measure from section views (m from the steering wheel's centre; the model's axes: x right, y up, z back): the speedometer (to 260 km/h) and the rev counter as round dials, a small digital cluster between them, the centre screen's pages on the tablet. Ambient lighting: warm amber.
